_comment: Post-activation chain facts, proven on X Layer Testnet AFTER the launch-time deployment manifest (1952.json) was frozen. The manifest records the venue as it was born: launch disabled, review not yet approved. This file records what has since been proven on chain and is the authority for LAUNCH/current public semantics. It is authored once and immutable; it never mutates the launch-time deployment evidence in 1952.json, which stays exactly as recorded at deploy time. Current operating mode is NOT recorded here: activation to NORMAL is historical, and the live mode must be read from the terminal/contracts, not hardcoded.
